help: Bounds are absolute endpoints in the corresponding axis units, not distances from the measurement. Supply both endpoints; they may be asymmetric. Leave bounds empty when unavailable. Use either value bounds or symmetric uncertainty.
invalid: Measurement bounds must use valid coordinates and finite numerical values.
complete: Supply both interval endpoints around a measured observation. Category coordinates cannot have intervals.
enclose: Interval endpoints must enclose their measurement; logarithmic interval endpoints must be positive.
conflict: Choose value bounds or symmetric uncertainty for an observation, not both.
heatmap: Use a measurement plot to display intervals; a heatmap cell represents one value.
mapping: Intervals can only be mapped for individual measurements. Select valid bound columns with compatible units.
description: Supplied measurement intervals are shown on their coordinate and value axes. Missing measurements remain gaps.
